title: Work Efficiency
description:
At the lower tiers, Work Efficiency is relatively simple: do what the abnormality likes. 

At higher tiers, paying attention to the Work Efficiency number after performing work is key.

At Eff. 75% and above, the work will always be good. Whatever you did, do it again.

At Eff. less than 25%, the work will always be bad. It's unlikely the work type is appropriate. 
Between 75% and 25% Eff., the work result may be either neutral or bad. This is random, with a higher efficency reducing the chance of bad results.

Research increases the work efficency by 5% per level.

The tier of abnormality after verdant lowers work efficency by 10% per tier. 

This is complicated, but you need to know this.
